text: B2a-r3: QB2-007 to QB2-011 read again; all were applied at B2b-r2-p2 and nothing of this leg rests on an assumption. B2a-r3 close: round 3 built (98 items: 44 unsplit and 54 children; 7 self-contained packets with fleet ids and codes_by_item; seed 20261013; the six parents left out); RETURN-B2.md unchanged since B2b-r2-p2; run_manifest.json round-3 entry; validate.py B2: 0 errors, 444 warnings, pasted into notes-B2.md; head updated (2,981 words). B2a-r3-p2 close: J's withdrawal applied (WITHDRAWN.json; author_items 50, gold_items 40; children's lines kept in _analysis; split records listed in notes-B2.md 'The split, withdrawn'; mem.py split refuses). Round 3 rebuilt on round 2's 50 items: 5 packets with fleet ids and codes_by_item, 0 room ids (J's 12:15 rule checked); the 98-item build kept at out/_analysis/b2_packets_round3_split_withdrawn/; run_manifest.json entry superseding B2a-r3's. validate.py B2: 0 errors, 443 warnings, pasted. Head updated (2,907 words). Closing with done.sh B2 --cut packets-out.

B2b-r3 opened. Round 3's returns read through the handler's rescue record (out/_fleet_raw/B2/round-3/RESCUE-2026-10-12.json): the first three valid replies per packet (P03-r3-1 r1 r2 r3; -2 r2 r3 r6; -3 r2 r3 r10; -4 r1 r2 r3; -5 r1 r2 r3), 150 lines; EXHAUSTED.tsv is superseded by the rescue record (the 8 exhaustions came from fleet.py counting third-order ids in multiplacement_log.additional as concept codes). b2_translate_fleet.py now reads only the kept replies and drops the readers' 'r/' prefix on sub: 150 lines translated, 0 id problems, copies in out/_analysis/b2_r3_returns/.

B2b-r3: J's 12:24 ruling applied: no one cuts the bags, neither this run nor the coders; a bag stays one item through B2 and B3 (one theme placed, others under also_present, three concepts of their own at least). Struck the line in notes-B2.md ('The B1 bags') and the head that waited for a coder recut.

B2b-r3: round 3 closed (out/_analysis/b2_score_r3.py on the translated kept replies; pilot_rounds.jsonl line 3). All 50: fidelity 0.682 (primary 0.780), against the rechecked placements 0.760, pairwise 0.728 (primary 0.793), alpha 0.721; 23 items with two readers differing (round 2: 27). Round-1 items (40): fidelity 0.611, pairwise 0.676, alpha 0.668. Ten biggest bags: fidelity 0.967, pairwise 0.933. Readers place two or more themes on 27 of 150 lines (round 2: 47). 18 lines name 145 themes under also_present, none under the three-concept floor. Against round 2 item by item: pairwise up on 17 items, down on 12, the same on 21. Edit 287 (T3-065 gloss) worked on guatemala t02 for 2 of 3 readers; nVade t04 moved from T3-195 to T3-005 for 2 of 3. 23 dividing items appended to exemplar_candidates.jsonl (68 lines).

asked QB2-012: Round 3 scored pairwise 0.728 on the 50-item hard set (fidelity 0.682, alpha 0.721), above the declared 0.70, so by stage B2 section 5 the rounds stop and no round 4 opens. Before the freeze the stage asks that every edited theme's gate pairs be confirmed (443 unconfirmed now) and every cluster read for a decide_when_both naming a theme with no discriminator. One cluster still divides readers at round 3: T3-002 (a call for hands), T3-033 (proposing the room's mark) and T3-038 (building and reporting a mark), on signal t01 (three readers, three themes), n64 t02 and 2007scape t04. Do you want the pair confirmations, the cluster reads and any sentence fix to that cluster done in a freeze leg of their own, with a fix there tested only by the gold round, or a round 4 on the fixed cluster first? | meanwhile: Rounds stop at round 3. This check leg writes no scheme edit. The pair confirmations, the cluster reads and the freeze are the next leg's work, and the gold round tests whatever the freeze changes.

asked QB2-013: validate.py B2 reports 4 errors in round 3: four kept return lines set item_is_a_bag true with also_present {} (P03-r3-2/r3.jsonl lines 6, 10, 11 on acecombat t05, n64 t02, Goodboye t03; P03-r3-2/r6.jsonl line 6 on acecombat t05). Each places one theme validly; r6 says the item is a bag but no other theme has three concepts of its own for also_present, so the flag and the three-concept floor collide. fleet.py accepted them. May I waive the four by name in out/return_waivers.jsonl, as at QB2-009 (reason: item_is_a_bag true with no theme at the three-concept floor; the placement scored as given), so the close-check passes? And should RETURN-B2.md and B3's return spec say that a bag with no other theme at the floor is not flagged a bag? | meanwhile: Round 3 is scored with the four lines as the readers gave them (their placements count; the bag flag is not used in any figure). No waiver is written without your word, so the close waits on this answer.

B2b-r3: notes-B2.md section 'Leg B2b-r3, check round 3' written: J's 12:24 ruling; the rescue record supersedes EXHAUSTED.tsv; fleet.py's counts (36 calls, 1.4904 USD, kept replies' durations and tokens); the three numbers against round 2; the edits' effect; the T3-002/T3-033/T3-038 cluster; the decision (rounds stop, QB2-012); the four bag flags (QB2-013).

B2b-r3 close: round 3 checked (fidelity 0.682, pairwise 0.728, alpha 0.721); rounds stop at the threshold (QB2-012 open, assumed: the freeze leg confirms the 443 pairs and reads the T3-002/T3-033/T3-038 cluster); no scheme edit; pilot_rounds.jsonl line 3; 23 exemplar candidates; J's 12:24 strike applied; the rescue record supersedes EXHAUSTED.tsv. validate.py B2: 4 errors (four bag flags with no also_present, QB2-013 open, no waiver without J's word), 443 warnings, pasted into notes-B2.md. Head 2,986 words. Running done.sh B2; the close-check is expected to refuse until QB2-013 is answered.

B2b-r3: QB2-012 answered (J 13:47): no round 4; a freeze leg of its own does the 443 gate-pair confirmations, the cluster reads for T3-002, T3-033 and T3-038 and any sentence fix there, tested only by the gold round in B2c. The assumption held; nothing to undo. QB2-013 answered: the four bag-flag lines waived by name in return_waivers.jsonl (20 lines; out/_analysis/b2_waivers_r3.py, ruled_by J QB2-013). RETURN-B2.md (round-3 text kept as out/_analysis/RETURN-B2_round3.md) now says a bag with no other theme at the three-concept floor is not flagged (item_is_a_bag false, also_present {}), and that also_present names 'twenty themes at most', a bound not a goal (J 13:47). Returns of rounds 1 to 3 are scored as given. validate.py B2: 0 errors, 443 warnings.
